title: Keeping the technology stack current
description: At Klee Group, I lead Java, Spring Boot, OpenSearch, and PostgreSQL upgrades on FSE+, addressing compatibility during each migration. I configured Renovate to manage minor and major dependency updates, helping the team address technical debt earlier.

title: Introducing Testcontainers to the business unit
description: I carried out the Testcontainers migration on FSE+, the first project in the business unit to adopt it. Other projects subsequently followed with support from the business unit technical leader.

title: Configuration changes without redeployment
description: For Richemont, through SQLI, I implemented multi-source configuration with Spring Cloud Config Server and added hot reload across the microservices platform. Configuration could then be updated without redeploying the services.

title: Automating engineering tasks with coding agents
description: At Klee Group, I use an existing agent platform to set up automation for ticket triage, bug fixing, and end-to-end test generation.
